step1_analysis.description: A fully differential dynamic comparator utilizing both NMOS and PMOS input pairs. The PMOS pair precharges the outputs to VDD during the clock-low phase, while the NMOS pair is in series with the cross-coupled regeneration pair to provide fast evaluation when the clock goes high.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the comparator during continuous clocking.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = f * C * VDD^2. With f=80MHz, C~50fF, VDD=1.8V, P ~ 13uW. Short circuit current during transition adds to this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Comparator power is a small fraction of the total ADC power. Dynamic power dominates.

decision_delay.description: Time taken from the rising edge of the clock to the output crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the transconductance of the input/cross-coupled pairs and the load capacitance. T ~ C / gm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: For an 80 MS/s ADC, the half clock period is 6.25ns. The comparator must resolve well within this time, typically < 1ns.

input_common_mode_range.description: The range of input common-mode voltages over which the comparator functions correctly.

sky130_expected.calculation: Requires PMOS to turn on for precharge (VCM < VDD - |Vthp|) and NMOS to turn on for evaluation (VCM > Vthn).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Vthn ~ 0.42V, |Vthp| ~ 0.42V. VCM must be between 0.5V and 1.3V for both pairs to operate.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench to measure the decision delay and average power consumption of the dynamic comparator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Comparator Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 N0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N8 N2 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N7 N5 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 N1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N5 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N5 N2 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N1 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N6 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVDD_N4 N4 0 1.8

* Clocks (80 MHz -> 12.5ns period)
VCLK0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 6n 12.5n)
VCLK1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 6n 12.5n)
VCLK2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 6n 12.5n)
VCLK3 LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 6n 12.5n)

* Inputs (VCM = 0.9V, VDM = 100mV)
VINP N0 0 0.95
VINN N1 0 0.85

* Load Capacitance
CL1 N2 0 10f
CL2 N5 0 10f

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.tran 10p 30n

.control
run
* Measure delay from CLK rising to OUT- (N2) falling to 0.9V
meas tran delay_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure average power
let power = -i(VVDD_N4) * 1.8 - i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power from=0 to=25n

print delay_fall avg_power
quit
.endc
